newsitem.title: USA: Penske Motorsports Q4 taxes, expenses rise.
newsitem.headline: Penske Motorsports Q4 taxes, expenses rise.

text.p: Penske Motorsports Inc on Thursday reported higher revenues but a wider loss in the fourth quarter ended December 31, when total expenses and income taxes increased versus 1995.
The company said revenues totaled $3.0 million, up from $2.6 million one year ago. Net losses in the period were $1.3 million, compared to a loss of $1.1 million in 1995.
The company said no racing events were scheduled in the fourth quarter of either 1996 or 1995.
Penske Motorsports markets and promotes professional motorsports races nationwide.
